A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ch.9.29
Another spelling of id.do (עִדּוֹ "Iddo" H5714I) 
§ Iddo = "appointed"
the seer who proclaimed to king Jeroboam of Israel
(Qal) to sweep, sweep away, sweep together

A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.6 
§ Jeuel = "God sweeps away"
son of Zerah and a chief man of Judah

wood, forest, thicket, wooded height
Another spelling of ya.ar (יַ֫עַר "wood" H3293A)

A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.21.19; 
father of: Elhanan (H0445)
Another name of ya.a.re o.re.gim (יַעֲרֵי אֹרְגִים "Jaare-oregim" H3296) 
§ Jair = "forested"
1) father of Elhanan the giant slayer, one of David's mighty warriors
1a) also called 'Jaare-oregim'

A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.10; 
son of: Bilhan (H1092H); 
brother of: Benjamin (H1144H), Ehud (H0164H), Chenaanah (H3668H), Zethan (H2133), Tarshish (H8659I) and Ahishahar (H0300)
§ Jehush or Jeush = "He hurries to aid"
1) son of Eshek, a remote descendant of king Saul
2) a Gershonite Levite of the house of Shimei
3) son of king Rehoboam of Judah
